baseline_observation.interpretation: This is command/control probe time, not real hot-path runtime latency.

goal: Break latency into components and identify whether the real pipeline is fast, blocked, inactive, or only boot/control-heavy.

decision_rules.boot_control_under_3000ms: acceptable unless repeated many times per minute
decision_rules.readmodel_stale_unknown: data missing, do not claim live speed
decision_rules.systemd_inactive: pipeline may be designed but not flowing
